options: The relatively flat terrain on which Antelope House was built allowed for the construction of large terraced buildings. 8% 选择

The location of Antelope House, an Ancestral Puebloan dwelling site in northeastern Arizona, provided an advantage to its inhabitants. 3% 选择
Since it was built under a rock overhang, Antelope House was naturally protected from heavy rain and snow. 正确选项 86% 选择
